statement: (∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1/2) → (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let A := fun (X d : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ d ∣ p+2)).sum (fun p => Real.log p); let D := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.floor (Real.sqrt X/(Real.log (2+(X:ℝ)))^5); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 3 ≤ X → (((Finset.Icc 1 (D X)).filter Odd).sum (fun d => Real.log d * |A X d-(X:ℝ)/(50*Nat.totient d)|))/(X:ℝ) ≤ C/(Real.log (2+(X:ℝ)))^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0059 · 将 GRH 进程误差绝对求和到近平方根截点
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0059 · Sum the absolute GRH progression errors to a cutoff below the square root

brief.zh: 逐模使用 TP-0030。d≤D≤X 时有 log d·log²(2dX)≪log³(2+X)，乘上 D/√X 后得到逆平方对数预算。
brief.en: Apply TP-0030 separately to each modulus. For d≤D≤X, the three log factors cost O(log³(2+X)). Multiplying by D/√X gives an inverse-square-log error.
